reviews.conclusion: Four visible pause/options visits total approximately 1.75-3.75 s, below the -4.95 s deficit. Two further narrow/obscured game-window phases span approximately 2.25-2.75 s and 3.25-3.75 s. Ordinary pause/capture context is directly visible, but hidden state prevents exact closure; these phases are not automatically counted as paused.
At End entry an options/video-settings sequence occupies approximately 1.0-1.5 s, compatible with the -1.3167 s deficit. Later inventory use remains distinct from pause-menu time.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
